SELECT cc.id AS id, cs.id AS companyServiceId, cs.business_id AS businessId, cs.service_id AS serviceId, sm.service_name AS serviceName, cc.company_name AS companyName, cc.tax_number AS taxNumber, ci.customer_name AS customerName, ci.contact_name AS contactName, ci.phone AS phone, cs.butler_owner_user_name AS butlerOwnerUserName, cs.effective_date AS effectiveDate, cs.end_date AS endEate, cs.actual_end_date AS actualEndDate, cc.company_type AS companyType, cc.create_time AS createTime, lr.renew_type AS lastRenewType, lr.remark AS lastRenewRemark, lr.renew_amount AS lastRenewAmount, sc.id AS contractId, sc.contract_no AS contractNo, sc.contract_price AS contractPrice FROM company_service cs LEFT JOIN customer_company cc ON cc.id = cs.company_id LEFT JOIN customer_info ci ON cs.customer_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN service_maintenance sm ON sm.id = cs.service_id AND sm.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT company_service_id, MAX(id) AS max_renew_id FROM company_service_renew WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY company_service_id ) lr_max ON lr_max.company_service_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN company_service_renew lr ON lr.id = lr_max.max_renew_id LEFT JOIN contract sc ON sc.id = cs.source_id AND sc.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY cs.actual_end_date ASC, cs.id ASC

SELECT cs.id AS id, sm.service_name AS serviceName, cs.effective_date AS effectiveDate, cs.actual_end_date AS actualEndDate, t.contract_price AS serviceAmount FROM company_service cs LEFT JOIN service_maintenance sm on sm.id = cs.service_id and sm.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN contract_detail cd ON cd.contract_id = cs.source_id AND cd.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN contract t ON t.contract_no = cs.source_number AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.deleted = 0 AND cs.company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY cs.id, sm.service_name, cs.effective_date, cs.actual_end_date ORDER BY cs.id DESC
